name: io.github.iflytek/astron-agent
title: Astron Agent
description: Call iFlytek Spark models and run workflows published from Astron Agent.

environmentVariables.name: SPARK_API_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Spark HTTP APIPassword, required for spark_chat

environmentVariables.name: SPARK_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default Spark model (4.0Ultra, generalv3.5, max-32k, generalv3, pro-128k, lite)

environmentVariables.name: ASTRON_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway URL of your Astron Agent deployment, required for workflow tools

environmentVariables.name: ASTRON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key of the application a workflow was published with
